title: Close the Loop
summary: You can now send feedback to Amp directly from your website. Enable the feedback widget in the settings for your project and add one script to your website. Then visit the site with ?amp appended, and the annotation widget is displayed. Click on any part of the page and write instructions for Amp. Once you are done, send the feedback to Amp.
